sources.notes: Primary pp110–112 and actual Plate IV figures4–5 C.ornatus, Springer collection USNM, prepared H.E.Wilson. Other figures are Comarocystites. Original excerpt lacked PlateIV; recovered whole-volume plate is actual fossil photography. Main biserial axes with short biserial brachioles, variable branch counts grouped three; documented fourteen-axis arrangement5/5/4 is a selected example, not universal. Laterals3.5–4mm and arm36–75mm are individual examples, not hard species ranges. Flattened column termination with marginal radicular extensions.
